title: Coverage-Gap Analysis: Cataloguing What METR and MALT Tasks Don't Cover in Monitoring Research

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Gap analysis is useful but indirect: it identifies blind spots rather than directly improving safety. The proposed task templates would need to be adopted by others to have impact. The chain from output to safety improvement has an extra step.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: No ML training required. Systematic tagging and analysis of publicly available task suites. Requires reading documentation, creating a categorization matrix, and writing up findings. Perfectly suited for CS students with intro ML background.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Clear deliverable: a coverage matrix and gap analysis document with proposed task templates. The scope is well-defined, though systematically tagging all METR and MALT tasks could be time-consuming. Feasible if limited to the most important dimensions.
